maya_cs: Quick note 30Apollo cohort 3 triggered a cost spike after they flipped embeddings on. Need a short QBR appendix + immediate mitigation.
liam_csm: Noted. Do we have the magnitude?
olivia_finops: Pulled numbers: expected ~100k tok/day, observed ~420k tok/day for cohort. Current commit 50k credits/mo. If sustained, monthly bill ~9M tokens (~$3.6k).
sam_engineer: billing-bot alerted at 08:05 `usage_anomaly account=apollo pct_change=+320%`. Root cause: client disabled local caching and small batch_size.
maya_cs: Can we give the customer a one-click fix they can paste in?
sam_engineer: Snippet:
```
// fix: enable cache + bump batch
client.setup({ embeddings: { cache: true, batch_size: 32 } })
```
Also recommend enabling client-side rate limiter.
liam_csm: For QBR appendix: 1) spike chart 2) root cause 3) one-click fix 4) forecast delta 5) suggested guardrails. Maya can you draft 5 slides?
maya_cs: Yes. Also propose a temporary soft cap while they patch?
olivia_finops: Recommend soft cap: 5 req/sec embeddings, 48h window; alert if 24h spend > $1,200. Add rollback instructions.
liam_csm: I'll own outreach and the Friday enablement walkthrough. Sam can you publish a gist with code + short explanation?
sam_engineer: Gist live: https://gist.github.com/sam/gh-xyz 5 includes code, monitoring snippet, and a link to the onboard playbook.
billing-bot: automated: created ticket CS-8412 "Apollo embed surge - QBR appendix + triage"
maya_cs: Scheduling 30m enablement Fri 10am PT. Agenda: apply patch, verify metrics, and confirm guardrails. I'll upload slides to the QBR folder and ping the CSM.
liam_csm: Add renewal-risk rule: if post-mitigation burn >2x commit for 7 days, flag to finance for renewal conversation.
